rationale: Only dedicated MK banking vertical portal; steady stream of bank/vendor rollout news that reveals awarded work.
Leading MK business portal naming vendor-bank implementation pairings absent from tender registers.
Standalone finance magazine; bank and IT-company rankings feed the vendor/actor map.
Established business magazine with deep archive for retrospective reconstruction of bank/vendor deals.
Secondary business portal; useful confirmation layer but largely redundant with stronger outlets.
Long-running economy weekly historically reporting banking deals and tender controversies.

News-agency economy desk carries central-bank/ministry statements earliest and verbatim.

Broadcaster with proven investigative capacity on state tender mechanics; monitor at domain level.

ICT trade media plus company directory; both an ongoing feed and the best local vendor-map instrument.

General news portal with thin procurement relevance; covered indirectly via the aggregator.

High-volume classifieds jobs vertical catching smaller PSP/integrator hiring; in-sector but an A5-style signal for this cell.
Minor job aggregator, largely mirrors larger boards; low incremental value for tenders.
Official state vacancy register, legally clear and stable; captures bank and state financial-institution postings.
Primary-source news/careers feed of a systemic MK bank; canonical first-party artefact to cite.
